PDF Fast Parallel Surface and Solid Voxelization on GPUs
Since voxelization is often a performance-critical, integral part, several algorithms have been proposed to perform voxelization of triangle meshes on the GPU, leveraging the fast rasterization pipeline for this 3D scan conversion.
